info.name: Alpen API
info.description:
Alpen Wege API (generated by build_postman.py from the API's OpenAPI description).

**Use:** import this collection and `Alpen API local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment, run **profile / auth / Login admin** once, then any call. Tokens last only a few minutes; the collection keeps the newest one automatically (header `X-Access-Token`). If a call answers 401, log in again.

**URL:** `http://{{hostname}}:{{port}}/{{api_path}}/<app>/<resource>`. Folders: one per app (core, compendium, explorer, profile, management), one per model inside.

**Variables:** `hostname`, `port`, `api_path` (= `api/v1`), `<who>_email` / `<who>_password` for admin, editor, viewer, guest, `new_user_password`, and `access_token`. Create calls save ids in variables such as `country_id`, `region_id`, `poi_id`; the next calls use them. For a full run with the Collection Runner: set `skip_deletes` to `true` (the Delete calls of the model folders are skipped), run the app folders in the order shown, then run the folder **Cleanup (optional)**, which deletes everything in the right order. The Upload CSV and Upload track calls need a file chosen in their body.

**Not covered:** WebSocket requests (see management / ws for the ticket and the URLs).

exec: // Random values for the Create calls (unique per call)
function letters(n) { var c = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', r = ''; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { r += c.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * c.length)); } return r; }
function alnum(n) { var c = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789', r = ''; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { r += c.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * c.length)); } return r; }
// ISO country codes starting with X are reserved for private use, so they never clash with real data
// The API sends a fresh token in the X-Access-Token header when the current one is half used up. Keep using the newest one.
pm.test("Database and Redis are up", function () { var d = pm.response.json().response_data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(d.redis_connected).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Logs in as the user made by Register (needs `registered_email`). Answers 401 or 403 when the account is not active yet; an administrator can activate it (profile/users, Activate user). The token is only saved on success.
